summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting May 2026 traffic statistics: guests grew 6% to 20.7 million with a 95% load factor, and rolling 12-month guests rose 4% to 210.4 million at 94% load factor. This is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing has no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
